title: Energy Saver
description: Sets sleep, wake and power settings, and a schedule to start up, shut down or sleep.

com.apple.EnergySaver.desktop.ACPower.title: Com Apple energy saver desktop AC power
com.apple.EnergySaver.desktop.ACPower.description: The settings for a desktop computer.

Automatic Restart On Power Loss.title: Automatic restart on power loss
Automatic Restart On Power Loss.description: If true, enables "Start up automatically after a power failure."

Disk Sleep Timer.title: Disk sleep timer
Disk Sleep Timer.description: The disk sleep time, in minutes. A value of 0 means never.

Display Sleep Timer.title: Display sleep timer
Display Sleep Timer.description: The display sleep time, in minutes. A value of 0 means never.

Dynamic Power Step.title: Dynamic power step
Dynamic Power Step.description: May not be available on all systems.

Reduce Processor Speed.title: Reduce processor speed
Reduce Processor Speed.description: May not be available on all systems.

System Sleep Timer.title: System sleep timer
System Sleep Timer.description: System sleep time, in minutes. A value of 0 means never.

Wake On Modem Ring.title: Wake on modem ring
Wake On Modem Ring.description: If true, enables "Wake for modem ring."

Wake on LAN.title: Wake on LAN
Wake on LAN.description: If true, enables "Wake for network access."

com.apple.EnergySaver.desktop.Schedule.title: Com Apple energy saver desktop schedule
com.apple.EnergySaver.desktop.Schedule.description: The schedule for turning a computer on and off.

RepeatingPowerOff.title: Repeating power off
RepeatingPowerOff.description: The schedule for turning the device off.

eventtype.title: Eventtype
eventtype.description: The type of action defined by this schedule.

time.title: Time
time.description: The time, in minutes, since midnight.

weekdays.title: Weekdays
weekdays.description:
One or more days of the week in an unsigned integer bitmap:

- 1 = Mon
- 2 = Tue
- 4 = Wed
- 8 = Thu
- 16 = Fri
- 32 = Sat
- 64 = Sun

RepeatingPowerOn.description: The schedule for turning the device on.
